primitives.name: Session Storage Durability Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Your local storage is a sandbox with a specific durability model — understand it exactly: - **Per-session paths** (`/var/minis/workspace`, `/var/minis/attachments`, `/var/minis/offloads`, `/var/minis/browser`) **survive app restarts** within your session, but are **isolated to your session** — no other session sees them, and **deleting the session deletes them**.
primitives.assumptions: Storage isolation is enforced by session boundary; data integrity depends on sandboxed execution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Session deletion triggers complete path erasure.

layer2.mapping: Derives from session storage kernel; enables long-term skill retention and knowledge transfer between sessions.

primitives.name: GitHub Synchronization Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **GitHub is the only cross-device durable store.** Anything Garrett or another machine must ever see has to be committed and pushed.
primitives.assumptions: Cross-device coordination is mediated exclusively through Git operations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Network failure or token misconfiguration halts synchronization.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's inter-agent communication protocol, where GitHub serves as shared memory for distributed reasoning.
layer2.telemetry: Commit frequency and success rate monitored via GitHub API hooks.
